published_ranges._ams: Compatible with original Bambu Lab AMS; not compatible with AMS 2; not tested on AMS Lite.
published_ranges._notes: Brass nozzle OK. Melting point 220C. Start ~255C and run a temperature tower. TPU flow often 93-96%. ISO 10993-5/-10/-23 tested. Diameter not stated on TDS.

conflicts: Product page 'Important Notice' strongly discourages using TPU with any AMS series (direct feed recommended); TDS says compatible with original AMS: https://siraya.tech/products/flex-tpu-64d-filament
